rationale.conceptual: Implementing the effective-field theory with correlations involves a custom operator expansion (recursive handling of hyperbolic functions and differential operators) specific to the hexagonal geometry. The method is standard in the field but non-trivial to code correctly: it requires careful translation of the Hamiltonian into coupled equations and root-finding for the Curie temperature. No off-the-shelf library provides this; the agent must implement the derivation.
rationale.execution: The reproduction consists of four sequential steps producing CSV files: solving the linearized transition temperature equation for three parameter sweeps, and solving the full nonlinear magnetization equations for one sweep. All use standard Python numerical libraries (numpy/scipy not even strictly required) with simple I/O. No external data acquisition, multi-tool orchestration, or heavy environment setup.
